text.15:26: Verily We created man of potter's clay of black mud altered,
text.15:28: And (remember) when thy Lord said unto the angels: Lo! I am creating a mortal out of potter's clay of black mud altered,
text.15:33: He said: I am not one to prostrate myself unto a mortal whom Thou hast created out of potter's clay of black mud altered!
text.55:14: He created man of clay like the potter's,
